profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced semiconductor manufacturing and systems professional with 10+ years in high-volume manufacturing environments supporting production systems, database infrastructure, and automated material handling systems (AMHS). Background includes 24/7 operations support, escalation management, equipment/system troubleshooting, and cross-functional coordination across engineering and manufacturing teams. Proven ability to support shift-based execution, improve system reliability, and contribute to operational continuity in mission-critical environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
·         Serve as the sole on-site software engineering resource supporting manufacturing system deployment, integration, and troubleshooting activities within a semiconductor fabrication environment. 
  
·         Act as the primary escalation point for software-related issues impacting local manufacturing operations, ensuring rapid resolution and minimal production disruption. 
  
·         Coordinate with global engineering teams and field service engineers to resolve production-impacting system issues in real time. 
  
·         Support deployment and release execution of manufacturing software systems used in high-precision semiconductor production environments. 
  
·         Deliver technical training and documentation to standardize installation and deployment procedures, improving operational consistency across field teams. 
  
·         Support cross-functional communication between engineering and manufacturing stakeholders to maintain system reliability in production environments.

positions.title: Manufacturing Systems Engineer
positions.description:
·         Supported manufacturing monitoring applications providing real-time visibility into equipment status and utilization across semiconductor fab environments. 
  
·         Collaborated with IT and factory engineering teams to troubleshoot system and connectivity issues affecting data reporting and application reliability. 
  
·         Improved reliability and availability of manufacturing monitoring tools used by operations teams to track equipment uptime and performance metrics. 
  
·         Participated in continuous improvement efforts focused on system performance, accuracy, and stability of manufacturing visibility tools.
  
·         Served as escalation support for application-related issues impacting factory monitoring and reporting.

positions.title: Adjustment Technician
positions.description:
·         Supported AMHS software installation, configuration, and validation in semiconductor manufacturing environments, focusing on application-layer functionality and system integration. 
  
·         Assisted with server setup, stocker system configuration, and system testing for automated factory systems. 
  
·         Operated in cleanroom and tool-install environments under strict safety and manufacturing compliance standards. 
  
·         Supported engineering teams during deployment and validation phases of AMHS systems.
  
·         Served as a co-lead responsible for training technicians and standardizing deployment procedures with another team lead.

positions.title: Manufacturing Associate III
positions.description:
•	Operated automated manufacturing equipment supporting production of blood glucose monitoring devices.
•	Responded to system alerts and recovered equipment to maintain >95% yield targets.
•	Assisted in training associates on alert recognition and recovery procedures.

positions.title: Database Administrator
positions.description:
·         Managed database performance and availability across global factory environments, maintaining >99% uptime.
  
·         Provided Level 2 on-call incident response for enterprise database systems supporting worldwide manufacturing operations.
  
·         Executed Oracle and Microsoft SQL projects including installations, migrations, and proactive system sustaining using Agile methodologies.
  
·         Trained new DBAs in operational procedures and incident management.
  
·         Technologies: Oracle Linux, Oracle Cloud (11g/19c), PL/SQL, Microsoft SQL Server 2012/2016.

positions.title: Production Line Coordinator
positions.description:
·         Coordinated shift-based production execution in semiconductor manufacturing environments using automated factory systems to support manufacturing schedules and operational priorities.
  
·         Supported response to production disruptions including equipment issues, material shortages, and system outages, coordinating with engineering and operations teams to restore stability.
  
·         Maintained operational continuity during high-priority factory events through escalation support and structured shift handoff coordination.

positions.title: Manufacturing Technician
positions.description:
·         Supported semiconductor fabrication operations including equipment troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, and process support. 
  
·         Maintained equipment uptime targets (>95%) through preventive maintenance and rapid failure recovery. 
  
·         Assisted with equipment installation, upgrades, and vendor coordination activities. 
  
·         Trained and mentored technicians on operational procedures and safety compliance.

positions.title: Initial Claims Representative
positions.description:
•	First responder in providing customers with world class claims service in auto insurance.
•	Develop problem solving and listening skills to provide customers with respect and care while documenting their claim.
•	Accurately record data into database and handle customer information with the highest respect for confidentiality.

positions.title: Member Services Associate
positions.description:
•	Offer an exciting shopping experience filled with customer care and value.
•	Process customer returns and resolve disputes while maintaining positive relationships with customers.
•	Maintain customer and product information in database.

positions.title: Manufacturing Technician
positions.description:
•	Lead trainer in preventative maintenance activities with the highest respect for safety and quality.
•	Operations lead overseeing production and maintenance activities to meet and exceed daily goals.
•	Maintain training records and equipment records in databases for accurate recordkeeping of technician progress as well as resolving equipment issues.

positions.title: Preventative Maintenance Technician III
positions.description:
•	Provide scheduled maintenance to correlate with manufacturing in achieving daily production goals.
•	Track SPC data to identify and resolve equipment issues.
•	Manage parts inventory to ensure an adequate supply of parts are available for PM’s.
•	5S champion responsible for sustaining cleanroom environment to 5S philosophy.
•	Knowledge of Hi-vac and chemical based processing equipment.
